# Fanfarr v0.5.17

Fanfarr finds theme music for a Plex library, writes it beside the media as a
local `theme.mp3`, and keeps a permanent record of what it did and why.

## Fixed: a working backup schedule reported as overdue

The System page said the last snapshot was overdue while nine recent snapshots
sat in the directory. Snapshots were sorted by filename, which is newest-first
only while every file shares a prefix -- and `pre-restore-` sorts above
`fanfarr-` because "p" comes after "f". A pre-restore from 26 September
therefore outranked October's automatic snapshots, and the health check, the
Backups card and the "newest" line all believed it.

The scheduler was never confused, because it considers only automatic
snapshots. That is why backups kept arriving while the page said none had: the
one path that decides whether to run was right, and every path that described
the result was wrong.

Sorting is now by the timestamp in the name, with the name breaking ties and an
unreadable name last, so an unknown age is never reported as the newest thing.

## Fixed: advisories in the web server and the data layer

Both were published after the previous release, and both were caught by the
audit step that runs in the local gate and in CI -- which is the reason that
step exists.

- **bandit** 1.13.1: an unvalidated HTTP/1 request-target authority let a client
  choose `conn.host` and `conn.port`. This is the web server itself.
- **ash** 3.37.1: `count`, `exists` and `aggregate` skipped a related
  resource's read policies in filters and sorts, and loading a through
  relationship with a limit of 1 ignored the through path.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and restart; the database migrates itself on boot.
